Requirement: Security: no high or critical vulnerability in the dependency scan of any Increment; card data never stored; access limited by role.
Basis type: Proposed (DoD 5, to be adopted by the Scrum Team); card-data part client-stated
Basis: DoD 5; PRD-SEC-001, SEC-003, SEC-011; REQ-KTDA-SEC-002; REQ-MPC-FR-148, FR-012, FR-013, FR-015, FR-021. The card-data part is native in 5.00.1: card storage was removed from the platform (§6.1)

Requirement: Privacy: personal data handled under the country data-protection profile, with consent, export, deletion, retention and breach handling. Law names (Kenya DPA 2019; Malawi DPA 2024) are inference (DP-01).
Basis type: Client-stated (KTDA LEG-001, ANL-008; MPC FRs); law names inference

Requirement: Audit: important actions logged to the platform audit trail with before/after values.
Basis: PRD-SEC-004, implemented by an IRepository<> decorator, not entity events (EntityUpdatedEvent carries only the new entity; some writes bypass events); REQ-MPC-FR-175, FR-274, FR-287, FR-298, FR-318

Requirement: Localisation: all user-facing text in language resources; right-to-left layout required for Arabic (KTDA LOC-001; inference, gap KG-14).
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA is proposed; the client states keyboard navigation and screen-reader support only (FR-092).
Devices and networks: phone, tablet and desktop; low-bandwidth behaviour. Page-weight / load-time target: Not stated in source — requires confirmation.
Data consistency: state-changing requests are idempotent; key tables use optimistic concurrency.
Basis: PRD-PLT-027 (row-version columns on core tables are a registered core modification; idempotency keys are plugin middleware), CHK-008; REQ-MPC-FR-114, FR-135, FR-297

Requirement: Configuration: no client-specific code in core; new settings added to the configuration-pack schema.

Service levels: response-time SLA stated by Malawi Post SUP-002 (1 h critical, 4 h high, 8 h medium; response or resolution not stated). Performance, availability, recovery time and recovery point: Not stated in source — requires confirmation (gaps KG-18, KG-02 volumes, MG-13). The catalog states search latency three different ways (FCAT-10); none is adopted.
